description: When the user has described their instruments, call this before writing MIDI code. Lists the MIDI instruments the user described in instruments.json, as facts: for each one its id, model, exact port name, whether it is connected right now, its channels and their roles, how many sounds it has, its bank select, its reset, whether it follows MIDI clock and its controls. Pass instrument (an id from that list) to get that instrument's full sound list, with the program number sent for each sound and its bank when it has one. A sound is chosen in the code with the sound option of .midi(). An instrument with a sound catalog shows how many sounds the catalog holds and its categories; search_midi_sounds finds them. For an instrument with a rhythm channel it says how a kit goes out and which drum map applies; with instrument set it lists each drum map as note numbers and drum names, a kit's own map only when it differs from the model's, and says when a kit has no known map. Drum notes are written as note numbers in the code. It also says which instruments the user switched off in the page: their notes are silent, and .midi() code newly aimed at them is refused until the user switches them on.

instrument.description: An instrument id from instruments.json, to list its sounds

name: get_midi_instruments
